summary: Hiker became lost then fell in 5th-class terrain on 13,403' South Arapahoe Peak; his daughter also became cliffed out; both evacuated by vertical rope rescue
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain Rescue Group (Boulder County SAR); Alpine Rescue Team (mutual aid)
